entities.summary: Oyèrónkẹ́ Oyěwùmí is a Nigerian gender scholar, a full professor of sociology and also "serves as a professor at the departments of Africana Studies, and Women's Gender and Sexuality Studies" at Stony Brook University, according to the Stony Brook News. Oyewumi has an expansive portfolio covering over three decades of teaching, research and intellectual leadership in academia before formally retiring in Spring of 2025. Oyewumi's research interests, while largely focused West Africa and Africa at large, they cut across epistemologies and theories such as gender, feminist, postcolonial, and uses these lens to deconstruct Western perspectives on its previous colonies.
